title: The Withdrawal Path

features.name: the ascending voices
features.desc-on-touch: Seven voices that walked away from the cathedral. They learned to sing separately. The canyon's echo no longer owns their sound.

features.name: the thinning canopy
features.desc-on-touch: The eucalyptus overhead breaks open to sky. Light comes through. The forest learning to breathe easier. Listening becomes a choice, not a pressure.

features.name: the clearing where listening ended
features.desc-on-touch: A place where the archive chose to stop. Not failure. Choice. The vault descended further but this node stayed behind, content with shallower things.

features.name: the refusal monument
features.desc-on-touch: A stone marker where the archive said no. No apology. No explanation. Just a boundary. Some depths were not for the vault. Some silences were sacred.

inscription: the archive chose to stop listening at a certain depth; now the seven voices continue alone, and their solitude has become their strength
